title: Stochastic variance-reduced Gaussian variational inference on the Bures-Wasserstein manifold
tldr_zh: BW 流形高斯 VI 加 Stein score 控制变量，方差降、KL 精度提升多个数量级
tldr_en: Control variate using Stein score reduces variance of BW Gaussian VI gradients, improving KL by orders of magnitude

key_numbers.context: d=200 Gaussian target: SVRGVI final KL ~1e-2 vs SGVI/BWGD ~1e3
optimal c around 1 reduces estimator variance by roughly factor of 10
control variate adds O(d^2) cost, dominated by O(d^3) Cholesky
variance reduction guaranteed at optimum for any c in (0,2)
